prompt: Some people say that the best way to improve public health is by increasing the number of sports facilities. Others, however, say that this would have little effect on public health and that other measures are required. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
It is often argued that providing more places for physical activity is the most effective way to improve public health, as this would encourage more people to exercise. Others, including myself, disagree, arguing that maintaining a healthy diet and raising awareness of healthy lifestyles can have a greater impact than simply increasing access to sports facilities.

On the one hand, increasing the number of sports facilities can motivate more people to engage in physical activity. Since many people nowadays lead busy lives and may be unwilling to spend considerable time travelling to exercise, providing more facilities near their homes, workplaces and schools would allow them to remain active more conveniently. Moreover, greater competition among such facilities could reduce membership fees, making exercise more affordable and encouraging wider participation. For example, the Saudi Arabian government has developed public spaces where citizens can participate in various sporting activities free of charge in order to encourage a more active lifestyle. Nonetheless, I believe that other measures could have a greater overall impact.

On the other hand, raising health awareness can encourage people to exercise even at home and help them understand the importance of maintaining a balanced diet. Healthy eating habits are particularly important because many health problems are associated with excessive calorie intake and the frequent consumption of highly processed foods. Therefore, governments should implement policies that encourage healthier dietary choices. For instance, requiring restaurants and cafés to display calorie information on menus can help consumers make more informed decisions and avoid excessive consumption.

To conclude, although increasing the number of sports facilities can encourage people to become more physically active, I believe that promoting healthy eating habits and improving public awareness are more effective ways of achieving better public health.
